title: Actual Q3 source-weighted direct D and delta-D audit
question: Do the actual Q3 direct D(t) and generator derivative delta_H D(t)=i[H,D(t)]/hbar remain finite and source-damped in both the Gibbs seminorm and the local-energy four-leg norm?

model.history: D_sigma(t,a)=U(H+sigma W_L,t) A_a U(H+sigma W_L,t)^* - U(H,t) A_a U(H,t)^*
model.normalization: divide both Gibbs seminorms and local four-leg norms by w_sigma(a)

adversarial_review.check: The primary definition delta_H D=i[H,D]/hbar is stated explicitly; the modular beta-scaled commutator is not silently substituted.
Unnormalized Gibbs and four-leg quantities remain recorded alongside their norm-level division by one scalar w_sigma(a).
K_X is applied in the full-H representation with no commutation assumption with rho, D, or delta_H D.
Three volumes, three beta values, four amplitudes, two cutoffs, one time, and two orientations are finite diagnostics only.
Finite D and delta-D rows do not establish a uniform common-core Cauchy estimate, exhaustion independence, or a common alpha.
Modular transfer, products, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Use the finite pair only as calibration. Define the corresponding local entire source seminorm on a common core and prove a source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform bound for both D and delta_H D before attempting direct Cauchy and exhaustion.
no_overclaim: This package tests the direct D/delta-D interface on finite actual Q3 matrices under a candidate source weight. It does not prove a uniform Cauchy theorem, common dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, or a Clay result.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational source-weight bookkeeping and the scalar generator-derivative normalization; Python checks actual Q3 matrices and trace identities.

qft_interface.closed: Finite actual-Q3 D and delta_H D rows are evaluated in both the Gibbs seminorm and the noncommuting local-energy four-leg norm, with independent trace reconstruction and source normalization.
qft_interface.open: A source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform common-core estimate, modular transfer, direct Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.
